Whilst in Pit Lane each Team member must display the associated identification as required by the Organiser .

Unless otherwise approved by the TD or their nominee, each Automobile is only permitted to stop/pit in its designated pit bay, in accordance with the Pit Lane Allocation published by the CM .

Whilst an Automobile is stopped/pitted in its designated pit bay, no part of the Automobile is permitted to encroach on the Fast Lane .

Unless otherwise approved by the TD or their nominee, whilst an Automobile is in Pit Lane , work is only permitted to be carried out on the Automobile whilst the Automobile is stopped/pitted in its designated pit bay.

During all Track sessions, all equipment associated with an Automobile must be kept as close as possible to the Automobile's designated pit bay and must not encroach on the Fast Lane .

Each Automobile must have its Pit Lane speed limiter activated when transiting Pit Lane .

During each practice and qualifying session:

Each Automobile must park nose-in on a 45-degree angle whilst stopped/pitted in its designated pit bay.

When leaving the pit bay, each Automobile must be pushed backwards into the Fast Lane by a Team member.

During each race, each Automobile is permitted to park parallel to Pit Lane whilst stopped/pitted in its designated pit bay.

If a practice or qualifying session is suspended (red flagged), unless otherwise advised by the RD via the RMC , each Automobile must either park nose-in on a 45-degree angle in its designated pit bay, or line up in the Fast Lane at Pit Exit .

Scrutineering at each Round will be conducted in accordance with the Motorsport Australia Targeted Scrutiny system.

Each Automobile must be presented for scrutineering at the appropriate times, in a complete and finished state and in 'ready to race' condition , including all markings and Seals on the Automobile in accordance with these regulations, associated Technical Appendix, Schedule K of the Manual , and the Commercial Agreement.

The TD reserves the right to seal any Automobile or component thereof for further examination at a later date, including after the completion of a Round . All costs associated with the further examination must be borne by the Competitor .

If a Seal, sticker or marking becomes illegible or is damage during a Track session, the Competitor must notify the TD immediately.

An incomplete RFI form will not be investigated and will be considered to be an unwarranted form.

A Competitor and/or Team member is not permitted to lodge an RFI form.
